Trump claims 'sick conspiracy' against AI and data centers

President Donald Trump stated on Monday that a "sick conspiracy" is targeting artificial intelligence and data centers. He asserted that the U.S. possesses the authority to regulate and prosecute companies involved in AI. Trump made these remarks while dismissing new guardrails intended for AI.
